headline: Qingdao Port report describes AI berth scheduling in routine use with reported planning time falling to minutes
summary: A Chinese-language report published on 10 October quotes a Qingdao Port automation-control center director describing a berth-planning agent built around 132 operational factors. The report says plan preparation moved from hours to minutes and that the berth agent was in routine operation with recommendation adoption above 90%. This is a second-hand media account hosted by Shandong’s propaganda department, not a port-owned technical record. The adoption figure is not plan accuracy or an independently measured productivity gain.
